ja: ●合戦には欠かせない！ 部隊兵が待望のBB戦士化！
●翔（青）、機駕（赤）、轟（黄）の各1体、計3体入りのセット
●肩と足首が可動、手には戟と剣、盾を装備可能
●盾は無限に連結可能、沢山集めて繋げよう
en: "BB Senshi 324 Troop Soldier" is now available!
-Indispensable for battle! Unit soldiers become long-awaited BB warriors!
-Set of 3 bodies, 1 each of Sho (blue), Kikan (red), and Todoroki (yellow)
-Shoulders and ankles are movable, and hands can be equipped with swords, swords, and shields.
-Shields can be connected infinitely, collect many and connect them
